assessment.label: Weekly newsletter open/click analytics
assessment.processing_description: Measuring open and click rates on the weekly customer newsletter to improve content relevance.

step1.interest_statement: Understanding engagement with existing customer communications to improve their relevance.

step2.alternatives_considered: Aggregate, non-identifying delivery-platform statistics were considered but do not support per-recipient content tailoring.

mitigating_measures: unrestricted opt-out beyond the Art. 21 legal minimum
